page: Microsoft Azure M416ms_v2 is a memory-optimized instance engineered for large-scale enterprise workloads and in-memory platforms. Powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8487C processors running on Microsoft Hyper-V, the system provides 416 vCPUs across 208 physical cores at clock speeds up to 4.0 GHz. The processor architecture includes 105 MB of L3 cache along with hardware support for AVX-512 vector extensions and cryptographic acceleration. It includes 11400 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 27.4 GB of RAM per vCPU, and integrates 8796 GB of local SSD storage.

Benchmark results demonstrate extreme multi-threaded throughput and memory capacity at scale, contrasted with moderate single-thread figures. In multi-threaded execution, the instance achieves top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core testing (279,384.01), PassMark CPU score (112,845.34), and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression (1,413.37 GB/sec). Memory throughput is high under cached conditions, measuring 19,469.58 GB/sec on small blocks and 691.64 GB/sec on large 256MB reads. In memory-bound applications, it produces 290.37 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and strong PassMark database scores. Conversely, single-core benchmarks such as Geekbench single-core (1103.0) and stress-ng single-core (1398.29) rank in the lower quartile, demonstrating that per-thread latency is traded for massive parallel execution.

Qualitatively, the M416ms_v2 provides resource density suited for consolidating massive databases that exceed standard cloud memory boundaries. The integration of 8796 GB local SSD storage supports fast scratch disk and swap operations alongside the 11.4 TB RAM footprint without provisioning auxiliary drives. The hardware profile makes it suited for large-scale SAP HANA deployments, massive in-memory databases, real-time analytics engines, and enterprise data warehousing platforms.
description: Microsoft Azure M416ms_v2 is an ultra-high-memory instance built on dedicated Intel Xeon 8487C processors, providing 416 vCPUs across 208 physical cores alongside 11400 GB of RAM and 8796 GB of integrated local SSD storage. Designed for extreme in-memory computing, it delivers exceptional parallel processing capability, marked by top-tier results in multi-core stress testing, PassMark CPU evaluation, and Redis operations reaching 290.37 million operations per second. While single-thread execution metrics reflect lower individual core speeds, the architecture achieves massive memory bandwidth and high concurrent throughput across its extensive core count. With roughly 27.4 GB of RAM per vCPU, the instance is structured specifically for memory-intensive enterprise environments, including massive in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, enterprise relational systems, and large-scale data analytics pipelines requiring multi-terabyte working sets.
